title: Enhancement: Batch related fixes workflow
description: Create prompt or script to apply multiple related fixes in one session. Example: Fix all accessibility issues together rather than one-by-one. Should suggest logical groupings based on labels (accessibility, performance, SEO).

title: Fix: Images missing alt text (accessibility)
description: Lighthouse audit failed: Image elements do not have [alt] attributes. Found in demo-app/index.html. WCAG 2.1 Level A requirement.
close_reason: ✅ All 7 images now have descriptive alt text. Lighthouse audit 'image-alt' now passes. Accessibility score improved 74→95.

title: Fix: Eliminate render-blocking resources
description: Lighthouse audit failed: CSS and JavaScript blocking initial render. Affects FCP/LCP. Recommend async/defer for scripts, critical CSS inlining.

title: Fix: Images missing width and height attributes
description: Lighthouse audit (score: 50): Images without explicit dimensions cause layout shifts (CLS). Add width/height to all img tags.

title: Fix: Missing meta description for SEO
description: Lighthouse audit failed: Document does not have a meta description. Impacts search engine rankings and click-through rates.

title: Enhancement: Automated before/after comparison
description: Script to automatically compare Lighthouse JSON reports and generate improvement summary. Could integrate with #web-quality-validate prompt. Output: table of score changes, audit improvements, regressions detected.

title: Fix: Insufficient color contrast for text
description: Lighthouse audit failed: Background and foreground colors do not have sufficient contrast ratio. WCAG 2.1 Level AA requires 4.5:1 for normal text.

title: Fix: Links without discernible names
description: Lighthouse audit failed: Links do not have a discernible name. Affects screen reader navigation. WCAG 2.1 Level A requirement.
